name: Charminar
description: Hyderabad landmark built in 1591 and a symbol of the city's historic old town and cultural life.
sourceNotes: Official destination description from Telangana Tourism. Coordinate is an approximate map reference for the monument.

name: Golconda Fort
description: Historic fortress and capital of the medieval Golconda Sultanate, part of Hyderabad's heritage circuit.
sourceNotes: Official Telangana Tourism page lists Golconda Fort among its museums and forts. Coordinate is an approximate fort reference point.

name: Ramappa Temple
description: The Kakatiya Rudreshwara (Ramappa) Temple at Palampet is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, inscribed in 2021.
sourceNotes: UNESCO World Heritage Centre is the primary heritage source. Coordinate is a mapped site reference; confirm visitor access locally.

name: Warangal Fort
description: Kakatiya-era fort precinct with distinctive gateways and monuments from the medieval capital.
sourceNotes: Official Warangal district visitor page. Coordinate is an approximate fort precinct reference point.

name: Kuntala Waterfalls
description: Waterfall on the Kadem river, about 64 km from Adilabad according to the district administration's visitor information.
sourceNotes: Official Adilabad district visitor page. Coordinate is an approximate waterfall reference; confirm seasonal access and local conditions.

name: Bhoodan Pochampally
description: Handloom destination in Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district known for Pochampally Ikat, including traditional double-Ikat weaving.
sourceNotes: Official Telangana Tourism arts and crafts page. Marker is a town-centre reference, not a specific workshop or visitor entrance.
